commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin || exit 51
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-public-datasets.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
export WORK
python3 - <<'PY'
from urllib.request import urlopen,Request
from urllib.error import URLError,HTTPError
from pathlib import Path
import csv,collections,datetime,hashlib,json,os,statistics
base='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SmartGreenHouses/NUTRICONTROL_datasets/main/'
paths=[
 'Alava_data/clean_data/Alava_15min.csv',
 'Cartagena_data/clean_data/Cartagena_comp0_15min.csv',
 'Navarra_data/clean_data/Navarra_comp0_15min.csv',
]
def temporal(value):
    s=value.strip()
    if not s: return None
    if s.endswith('Z'):s=s[:-1]+'+00:00'
    try:return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
    except ValueError:return None
for i,path in enumerate(paths):
    local=Path(os.environ['WORK'])/f'site{i}.csv'
    try:
        with urlopen(Request(base+path,headers={'User-Agent':'BloomML-public-research-audit'}),timeout=45) as fh,local.open('wb') as fp:
            while True:
                part=fh.read(1024*1024)
                if not part:break
                fp.write(part)
                if fp.tell()>25_000_000:raise RuntimeError('Dataset download exceeds 25 MB size limit')
    except Exception as exc:
        print('DATASET_FETCH_FAILED|',path,'|',type(exc).__name__,str(exc)[:160],sep='')
        continue
    size=local.stat().st_size
    hash_value=hashlib.sha256(local.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    try:
        with local.open('r',encoding='utf-8-sig',errors='replace',newline='') as f:
            reader=csv.DictReader(f)
            names=reader.fieldnames or []
            preview=[]
            n=0
            nonempty=collections.Counter()
            candidates=[k for k in names if any(term in k.lower() for term in ('temp','hum','co2','vent','window','radiat','fan','dest','heater','time','date'))]
            timestamp_keys=[k for k in names if any(t in k.lower() for t in ('time','date','timestamp'))]
            tsfirst=tslast=prev=None
            gap=collections.Counter()
            nonmonotonic=duplicates=0
            for row in reader:
                n+=1
                if n==1:preview=[(k,row[k][:65] if row[k] is not None else None) for k in names[:8]]
                for k in candidates:
                    val=row.get(k,'')
                    if val is not None and str(val).strip() not in ('','nan','NaN','null','None'):
                        nonempty[k]+=1
                for tk in timestamp_keys[:1]:
                    t=temporal(row.get(tk,''))
                    if t is not None:
                        if tsfirst is None:tsfirst=t
                        tslast=t
                        if prev is not None:
                            dt=round((t-prev).total_seconds())
                            gap[dt]+=1
                            if dt<=0: nonmonotonic+=1
                            if dt==0: duplicates+=1
                        prev=t
            summary={'source_path':path,'bytes':size,'sha256':hash_value,'rows':n,
                 'columns_count':len(names),'column_names':names[:90],
                 'example_first_row':preview,'datetime_column_candidates':timestamp_keys,
                 'first_datetime':str(tsfirst),'last_datetime':str(tslast),
                 'top_intervals_s':gap.most_common(6),'nonmonotonic_steps':nonmonotonic,
                 'duplicate_timestamps':duplicates,
                 'nonempty_selected':{k:nonempty[k] for k in candidates[:35]}}
            print('PUBLIC_SITE_AUDIT_JSON|'+json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
    except Exception as exc:print('DATASET_READ_FAILED|',path,'|',type(exc).__name__,str(exc)[:200],sep='')
print('DATASET_AUDIT_DONE|public data only, raw files deleted on exit')
PY
